harness_hints.vcs: Sapling (`sl`). Never run git commands in this repo.
harness_hints.close_out: After kickstart/loop, ask before committing. If yes, this chat writes the commit with the repo VCS and omits `*.plan.md`. Do not auto-run `dn land`. Use `dn land` in CLI, CI, denoise, `--issue-testplan`, or when the user names it.
harness_hints.trunk: `make sync` / `dn sync` publishes to trunk after a local commit; `dn sync --pr` opens a PR from local commits. Distinct from land.
harness_hints.nested_agent: Do not pass `--agent` for this outer harness unless asked (no Cursor-in-Cursor, no Codex-in-Codex).

lint.intent: Fix format, typecheck, and lint failures until make lint exits 0.

tests.intent: Fix failing tests until make tests exits 0. Prefer production-code fixes when tests are correct.

precommit.intent: Fix fmt, lint, typecheck, and workflow checksum drift until make precommit exits 0. Update templates/workflows/manifest.json when workflow templates change.
